feat: Solaris v0.0.8 — core v2 server, native storage, entity layout

Replace the v1 server with core v2 (`solaris-v2`): one native tick with
parallel snapshot reads, owned intents and a deterministic serial merge;
native store plus tick WAL, offline Anvil import/export (ADR 0013/0014).
The v1 crates mc-server, mc-net, mc-simulation and mc-entity are removed.

Gameplay since v0.0.7 includes Nether/End and the dragon fight, special
mobs, mounts and vehicles, wave 3 mechanics (sculk/warden, trial chambers,
mace, crafter, copper, bees/allay, raids, conduits), statistics,
advancements, scoreboards, piglin bartering, armor stands, fishing,
player-built iron/snow golems, elytra gliding and beacons. PlayerCommand
actions follow the 26.1.2 seven-entry enum.

Entity layout (committee decision 013): rare components boxed, sorted type
lanes instead of full-row scans, and a dense single-owner Body column.
fp native-100 rises from 14.5 to 15.9 TPS and RSS drops by 415 MiB.

Wasmtime plugin packages load from [plugins].directory; the manifest
parser accepts inventory_storage_transactions. CI pins the rebuilt
sibling loader and plugin revisions.

Vanilla loot, enchantment and light tables load at runtime from the
imported content cache (CoreRegistry); Mojang data is no longer compiled
into the binary. CI extracts local test data from the verified server jar.
